standard: Natural clear prose and useful technical guidance; no human-authorship inference.

findings.issue: Abstract opening: establish a smaller fact, approved identity, intended query.
findings.requested_edit: Open with the team replacing a reporting endpoint while accounts remain in SQL Server. Explain the first check with ordinary words.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: Forced closing link to unrelated prompting article; bound request and useful handoff read like an editorial template.
findings.requested_edit: Close on comparing the same account identifiers, missing rows, and nullable fields in old and new endpoints.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: Connection helper uses OCI call timeouts; a generic Oracle Client11.2 minimum would be too broad.
findings.requested_edit: State Oracle Client18.1+ for this fixture and distinguish crate minimum from example requirements.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: Db2 fixture needs actual engine identity if it claims a pinned server target.
findings.requested_edit: Read service level from the real connection and compare with a declared expected version; do not claim unexecuted server proof.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: selfcheck and an abstract closing list make otherwise concrete prose feel formal.
findings.requested_edit: Use example or test, and finish on file location, migration, and restore checks.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: information it no longer owns is abstract wording in a transaction retry explanation.
findings.requested_edit: Say an old balance or an old decision.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: initialization contract and established that the referenced row existed can be expressed more simply.
findings.requested_edit: Describe the opener checking the setting, and the type not proving that a project exists.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: Matching only query().await may miss a SQL Server error returned while reading the TDS result stream.
findings.requested_edit: Await query creation and stream.into_row() in the Result used to classify a lock timeout.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: Remote CI rejected an immutable Oracle connection before set_autocommit(false).
findings.requested_edit: Use a mutable binding in the shared Oracle connector.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: All memory-limit cases could accept out-of-memory errors without validating a successful result.
findings.requested_edit: Require a generous-memory baseline to complete and verify rows plus independent sum; report spill only if measured.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: SQLx0.9 rejects a dynamically formatted isolation statement through SqlSafeStr.
findings.requested_edit: Choose between fixed SQL literals for the two isolation modes.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: DuckDB2.0 rejects a .json profiling_output while the current output format is still query_tree.
findings.requested_edit: Enable JSON profiling before setting its JSON filename.
findings.status: revised in the draft sources; final CI tracks executable changes

findings.issue: The observer sees the old committed note even if an update remains uncommitted, so its read alone cannot prove rollback.
findings.requested_edit: Check the writer-side note after rollback, then check the observer; explain each read.

findings.issue: RESTRICT should preserve all affected rows, not merely report an error.
findings.requested_edit: Require a constraint error and check project/member/task counts before the later successful delete.

findings.issue: Any SQL error was being treated as evidence that the CHECK constraint rejected a negative value.
findings.requested_edit: Require the engine-specific CHECK error and reread the unchanged quantity.

findings.issue: An invalid JSON insert accepted any error as proof of validation.
findings.requested_edit: Require MySQL3140 or MariaDB4025 and verify the invalid row is absent.

findings.issue: Plain EXPLAIN output was labelled an actual plan.
findings.requested_edit: Label it an EXPLAIN plan; distinguish estimated operator placement from executed read metrics.

findings.issue: The readiness signal precedes the SQLite call and cannot prove measured entry into its lock wait.
findings.requested_edit: Describe the submitted write as pending; move blocking worker shutdown off the runtime thread.

publication: All thirty approved for immediate release with draft:false, reviewed:true and exact review hashes; existing schedules are unchanged.
runtime_limit: SQL Server, Oracle and Db2 service runs remain pending; client compilation and independent Rust checks do not establish those integrations.
